name: Citizenship by Marriage

requirements.blocker_text: The 2004 Nationality Code equalized derivative nationality through marriage for men and women -- a foreign spouse of a Congolese national (regardless of the spouse's gender) can acquire nationality through marriage, subject to residency/waiting-period conditions not further specified in sources reviewed. This replaced a prior regime under which a Congolese woman automatically lost her nationality upon marrying a foreigner.
requirements.fix_path: Marry a Congolese citizen and apply after satisfying the residency/waiting-period conditions.

evidence_required.document: Proof of residency period (exact length unconfirmed)

sources.title: Wikipedia -- describes the 2004 Nationality Code's equalization of marriage-based nationality acquisition for both genders, replacing the prior automatic-loss-on-marriage rule for Congolese women
Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative -- corroborates that derivative nationality by marriage exists but does not detail the residency/waiting-period conditions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Democratic Republic of the Congo).
